original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Sharp universal cardinality of noncoordinate binary rank-one-idempotent pools in a d-dimensional off-diagonal pattern space, with an explicit attaining common-row family.
scope_change_reason: The card is changed from native larger-register construction to a scalar reconstruction side result, following the explicit pattern-space classification question in woklerx PR1456. It neither realizes a rational two-relation word nor extends the separate PR5231 rational span-six obstruction.
bottleneck_link: Side result: a fixed pattern dimension gives a sharp finite pool size independent of ambient register count, before any chronological word or native supplier search. The original native acceptance gate remains unmet.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified sharp pool-size theorem and its attaining family. No word synthesis, flag census, successor construction or supplier expansion.
evidence: PROOF.md establishes |P(V)|=|R(V)|+e(V)<=2^d+d-1 and sharpness for W>=d+1. New exact checks enumerate 2501 noncoordinate projectors on five/six roles, 141888 diagonal completions, 110685 five-role spanning pairs and 55 attaining star shapes containing 4237 literal projectors.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Which off-diagonal pattern spaces attain the cardinality maximum?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An equality classification could remove redundant extremal families before word synthesis.
open_questions.first_step: Impose equality in the realized-pattern and matrix-unit counts, then classify the directed-edge sets.
open_questions.blocked_by: This contribution proves one attaining common-row family but does not classify every maximizing space.

open_questions.question: What is the sharp joint-image dimension at fixed pattern dimension?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It could lower the ambient threshold beyond which a nonempty pool must be reducible.
open_questions.first_step: Start with d=2 while retaining every possible diagonal lift.
open_questions.blocked_by: Cardinality bounds the image dimension but may be loose; adding coordinate gates to full words has a separate contract.

selection.overlap_scope: Live open PR bodies, account PRs, latest handoff comments and active Discussions; cached task search with sparse local omissions; committed README Git searches and targeted merged PR searches. Arbitrary code diffs and unpublished work are not fully covered.

freshness.decision: Continue completed scoped theorem. Canonical main and relevant guidance are unchanged; live claims and new PR titles are disjoint. Cached card overlap covered 470 open PRs and 5426 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; sparse local omissions were supplemented by committed README searches.
